title: WebDAV Server
descript: A ready-to-use WebDAV server with read-write access, PROPFIND support and per-app credentials. This package runs the Docker Hub image as a non-root container, rebuilds nginx on port 8080 and stores everything under the application data folder. Only the x86_64 package is built because the upstream image only publishes amd64.
important: The root page shows the server status. Connect WebDAV clients to http://<NAS-IP>:8112/ with user "tos" and the password in /Volume1/DockerAppData/webdavdocker/media/.webdav-password. Files live in that folder and survive updates. The container runs as uid 1000. Needs DockerEngine; configure a registry mirror if Docker Hub is unreachable. Plain HTTP on the LAN.

github.description: A self-hosted habit tracking app without "Goals"

zh-cn.descript: 习惯打卡与连续天数统计，界面简洁。
zh-cn.important: 首次使用请打开网页完成初始化。数据保存在 DockerAppData/beaverhabitsdocker，重启和升级不会丢失。容器以 uid 1000 运行，挂载目录需对该用户可读。需要 DockerEngine；Docker Hub 不可达时先配置镜像加速。卸载并删除数据前请备份。局域网内为 HTTP。
